q_a.question:
can I take this power bank on a airplane?

TSA web site says Lithium metal (non-rechargeable) batteries are limited to 2 grams of lithium per battery. Lithium ion (rechargeable) batteries are limited to a rating of 100 watt hours (Wh) per battery.
q_a.answer:
All of our PowerCores have capacities that meet the requirements to be taken on airplanes as carry-on baggage, but they are not allowed to be transported in checked luggage.  Please confirm with your airlines on how many power banks they allow a person to carry on, as most only allow two, and travel requirements are subject to change.

I looked at several and landed on this. So glad I went with this one. Works works just as good today as it did the first day I got it. Charges things super quick and can handle charging my laptop, cell phone, and wireless headphones all at the same time while also doing it quickly. 

Amazing product that I’d highly recommend to anyone. It also recharges from 0 to 100% and under 45 minutes. I would say I have charged well over 800 times and I have not seen any degradation in charging performance. 

The battery life cycle is still at 95% after all of that. Not to mention the durability as I have dropped this thing several times.
